metadata.description: Claude skills for LinkedIn company Pages: brand profile research, Page optimisation, trend and competitor intelligence, multi-surface content calendars, Page posts and document carousels, authority articles and newsletters, de-AI and de-corporate humanizer, repurposing, proof extraction, employee amplification, comment desk, monthly reporting.

plugins.name: linkedin-company-page-skills
plugins.description: 13 single-purpose skills for running a LinkedIn company Page, built on the 2026 reality that a Page reaches 1-2% of its followers and has to borrow distribution from people. Includes a claim-gated writing path (no figure publishes without a cleared proof row), a humanizer that strips press-release voice as well as AI tells, an employee amplification layer with per-person angles rather than one shared caption, and honest handling of the surfaces LinkedIn exposes no API for.
